question: Over 5,000 athletes were competed in _________sports for 1,936 medals in the 5th edition of Khelo India Youth Games in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**27**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **27 sports** were featured in the 5th edition of Khelo India Youth Games in 2023.
 
• The event saw the participation of over 5,000 athletes.
 
• A total of 1,936 medals were awarded during the games.
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative by the Indian government to promote sports and identify young talent across the country.
 
• The event includes a wide range of sports, from traditional Indian games to modern Olympic disciplines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India initiative was launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The program aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It includes several components such as scholarships for talented athletes, the creation of sports infrastructure, and the organization of annual sports events.
 
• Since its inception, Khelo India has significantly contributed to the identification and nurturing of young sports talent across the nation.
